note: Pre-registered strategies. Definitions frozen before Week 11 kickoff (2026-11-19 8:15 PM ET). No backtest number may appear on the leaderboard. Each strategy carries a two-sided what-would-change-our-mind field.

strategies.name: Shadow singles baseline (team-strength, opponent-aware)
strategies.definition: P(home win) from season NET/game + home edge; spread = rating diff; total = league mean total; ML derived from spread. No injury features in v1.
strategies.what_would_change_our_mind_up: Brier skill vs favorites-only control with lower bound > 0 over >= 50 graded games.
strategies.what_would_change_our_mind_down: Brier skill lower bound <= 0, or MAE worse than naive baseline.

strategies.name: Totals estimator A (points-based)
strategies.definition: Total = mean(PF+PA)/games league-wide, split by team pace proxy (PF+PA per game).
strategies.what_would_change_our_mind_up: Walk-forward MAE beats estimator B over >= 50 graded games.
strategies.what_would_change_our_mind_down: Walk-forward MAE loses to estimator B.

strategies.name: Totals estimator B (net-based)
strategies.definition: Total = league mean total adjusted by combined NET (high-NET matchups score more).
strategies.what_would_change_our_mind_up: Walk-forward MAE beats estimator A over >= 50 graded games.
strategies.what_would_change_our_mind_down: Walk-forward MAE loses to estimator A.

strategies.name: Two-leg parlay (joint-evidence gated)
strategies.definition: Only ranked when a directly validated joint probability AND operator void/push rules are both available. Currently ineligible.
strategies.what_would_change_our_mind_down: Remains ineligible; never ranked on multiplied marginals.

strategies.name: Same-game parlay (joint-evidence gated)
strategies.definition: Same gate as ST-04. Currently ineligible.
strategies.what_would_change_our_mind_down: Remains ineligible; never ranked on multiplied marginals.

strategies.name: Player-prop combo (joint-evidence gated)
strategies.definition: Same gate as ST-04. No official per-game player logs exist. Currently ineligible.
strategies.what_would_change_our_mind_up: Official per-game player logs + validated joint probabilities.
